results.title: Actuary Salary in Australia: What You Can Expect to Earn in 2026 - Remitly
results.description:
## What does an actuary earn in Australia? (quick answer)
**The Actuaries Institute reports average annual starting pay from $85,000 for graduates, although actual salaries vary by employer, location and experience.**

- Mid-career (3–6 years): $110,000–$150,000, based on SEEK job ad data.

## Actuary salary in Australia by experience level
|  |  |  |
|-|-|-|
| Graduate (0–2 years) | From $85,000 (Actuaries Institute average starting pay) | Foundation Program complete, working through Actuary Program subjects |
| Mid-career (3–6 years) | $100,000–$150,000 | Progressing through Actuary Program subjects and practical experience toward Associate (AIAA) |
| Senior (7–12 years) | $150,000–$190,000 | Often Associate (AIAA) qualified; some progressing toward Fellowship |

## Actuary salaries by city in Australia
|  |  |
|-|-|
| Sydney | $112,500 |
| Melbourne | $192,900 |
| Brisbane | $134,700 |
| Perth | $136,500 |

## Key takeaways
- Graduate actuaries in Australia start on average annual pay from $85,000, per the Actuaries Institute; actual salaries vary by employer, location and experience.
